If EthTrcv_SetTransceiverMode() is called with parameter ETH_MODE_ACTIVE or ETH_MODE_ACTIVE_WITH_WAKEUP_REQUEST, EthTrcv WakeupSleepOnDatalineEnabled is not configured and the internal cable diagnostic state is different from ETHTRCV_CABLEDIAG_PENDING, the Ethernet Transceiver driver shall: • Check for wake-up reasons when entering the transceiver's active mode; • If no wake-up reason has been detected, the Ethernet transceiver shall send a wake-up symbol on the bus if configured; 32 of 90 Document ID 431: AUTOSAR_SWS_EthernetTransceiverDriver Specification of Ethernet Transceiver Driver AUTOSAR CP R21-11 • Invoke the call-out <EthTrcvWakeUpCallout> function if configured.

If EthTrcv_SetTransceiverMode() is called with parameter ETH_MODE_ACTIVE or ETH_MODE_ACTIVE_WITH_WAKEUP_REQUEST, EthTrcv WakeupSleepOnDatalineEnabled is not configured and the internal cable diagnostic state is different from ETHTRCV_CABLEDIAG_PENDING, the Ethernet Transceiver driver shall: • Check for wake-up reasons when entering the transceiver's active mode; 32 of 97 Document ID 431: AUTOSAR_SWS_EthernetTransceiverDriver Specification of Ethernet Transceiver Driver AUTOSAR CP R22-11 • If no wake-up reason has been detected, the Ethernet transceiver shall send a wake-up symbol on the bus if configured; • Invoke the call-out <EthTrcvWakeUpCallout> function if configured.
